{{Quote|Grathan's trouble, see. Big trouble. Mad scientist type. Likes weapons. Cyborgs. Droids. Ergonomic chairs.|Bryn, to an Imperial individual|<ref name="SW" />}}
'''Bryn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served in the [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|Special Forces]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], around [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where he performed reconnaissance on [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]], a rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who had declared himself the thirteenth member of the [[Dark Council]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Those turret schematics are going to revolutionize Imperial weaponry. We need them. Fast.|Bryn|<ref name="SW" />}}
Bryn held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] within [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|Imperial Special Forces]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At one point during his career,<ref name="SW" /> around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Year">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he was stationed on a bridge on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] between [[the Wall]] and the [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]] of rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]],<ref name="Kaas" /> the self-proclaimed thirteenth [[Dark Council]] member.<ref name="Grathan Forces">{{TORcite|type=codex|Grathan Forces}}</ref> At this position, he was tasked with keeping watch on Grathan while maintaining his distance. As part of his orders, he was to retrieve the plans for a [[Unidentified prototype turret|prototype turret]] that his superiors wanted to mass-produce, but his orders also specified that he could not enter Grathan's territory. He requested the aid of a passing individual affiliated with the Sith Empire to retrieve the plans.<ref name="SW" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
[[File:PrototypeTurret-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|250px|Bryn was tasked with retrieving the plans for a prototype turret.]]
The Imperial individual successfully infiltrated Grathan's compound, retrieving a security badge from a member of [[Lord Grathan's forces]] in order to pass by its automated defenses. The individual broke into [[Grathan weapons lab|Grathan's weapons lab]] and downloaded the plans from the [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[PO-12]], much to its chagrin; it wanted to destroy the schematics and ensure no more [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] could be built. Upon the individual's return, Bryn displayed an eagerness to test the efficacy of the turrets on Republic personnel.<ref name="SW" />
{{Endgame}}

After the individual's mission, Bryn remained posted on the bridge, continuing to keep watch over Grathan's estate.<ref name="Kaas" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Shh. Can't be seen. Can't be heard. Sensitive business, this. Dangerous man, Lord Grathan.|Bryn|<ref name="Kaas" />}}
Bryn was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Kaas" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Male" /> with light skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a short mustache. His right cheek was lightly scarred by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Cold War.<ref name="Kaas" /> Bryn held the orders he received highly, forcing him to ask for assistance in retrieving plans from Grathan's estate.<ref name="SW" /> The captain considered the details of his operations to be sensitive and Grathan to be a dangerous individual.<ref name="Kaas" />

==Equipment==
Bryn wore a gray [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]]. He wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Kaas" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'm extremely disappointed. Extremely. Because now I have to report back that my mission was a failure&mdash;and it's your fault!|Bryn, if the player chooses to let PO-12 destroy the plans|<ref name="SW" />}}
Bryn first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] online [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Kaas" /> He acts as a non-player character who can give the "Strange Weapons" exploration mission to Imperial players on Dromund Kaas. Players have two options during the quest: they can download the turret plans for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark alignment]] points or remove PO-12's [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] to allow the droid to delete the plans for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light alignment]] points. If the player retrieves the plans, Bryn expresses an eagerness to take the plans to his superiors. If the plans are destroyed, Bryn instead reacts with anger, stating that he will need to attempt to save his job.<ref name="SW" /> This article assumes that the player chose the dark-side option.
